text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kuwait to offer 60 million Gulf Bank shares for public subscription on February 2. Kuwait has sold 30 million shares in the bank in a public auction earlier in January under a privatisation plan.
- Sudan did not seek military support from Iran, official says.
- Active trade at the Kuwait Stock Exchange on Wednesday. Investment firms led.

- Kuwait spends 65 percent of its revenue from oil on wages of civil servants, planning minister says. The state is obliged by law to provide jobs for all Kuwaiti job seekers. Most of Kuwait's national workforce is hired by the state.
